dedupe_keys.name: data for fire dynamics simulator fire in a tunnel under construction

description: This Mendeley Data deposit provides the input data of a Fire Dynamics Simulator case for a fire in a tunnel under construction, prepared by Stefano Bondua and Lorenzo Tagliati. The modelled tunnel is 100 metres long, 10 metres wide and 7 metres high; the fire starts in a spoil transport truck of 13.6 by 2.6 by 2.6 metres parked 30 metres from the entrance, a drilling jumbo stands 30 metres from the excavation face and a duct system supplies fresh air. It is meant for numerical modelling of smoke and ventilation and runs in the open NIST Fire Dynamics Simulator, which users download separately. The record was published on 4 October 2023 under CC BY 4.0, free to download, and the exact file formats are not listed on the page. Coverage is a single hypothetical site. Caveats: it is one scenario without measured validation data and has no update plan. It suits emergency response and fire hazard studies of tunnels and confined works. Related catalogue record: model-nist-fds-smokeview, the simulator it drives.
